Chapter 817: Chapter 20 Child Of The Void (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 817: Chapter 20 Child of the Void (Please Subscribe)_2

There should be located deep within the Void Secret Realm, even Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit cannot forcefully enter.

Directly killing the Tianzhi True Lord’s true body does not solve the issue of his ‘avatar’.

But causing the Tianzhi True Lord’s true body to fully fall into slumber… As the true body shares memories with the avatar, when the true body falls into slumber, so does the avatar.

Although Lin Yuan was already prepared for his existence being discovered in the Tianqing World, it is better to delay this as much as possible.

In fact, the mental will of Tianzhi True Lord is very strong, even stronger than Lin Yuan, but, unfortunately, his use of mental will is rather crude.

Among human civilizations in the Main World, one of the nine strongest beings, the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, excels at illusions, the ultimate existence based on illusions.

...

Lin Yuan had long thoroughly researched the evolutionary path of Feather Butterfly, understanding many illusionary techniques thoroughly; plunging Tianzhi True Lord fully into slumber was not difficult.

“I’ll have a look at your memories…”

Lin Yuan, with his immense mental will, crafted a realistic ‘illusion’ for Tianzhi True Lord to indulge in, naturally allowing him to browse through Tianzhi True Lord’s own memories through the ‘illusion’ if he wished.

Momentarily after.

Lin Yuan appears contemplative.

“Boundless Void… Void Secret Realm… that disappeared originator… and the Child of the Void or should I say, Void Divine Master?”

Through browsing the memories of Tianzhi True Lord, Lin Yuan’s understanding of the entire Boundless Void instantaneously reached a terrifying extent. Tianzhi True Lord knew too many secrets, and now they all ended up benefiting Lin Yuan.

“Void Divine Master?”

Lin Yuan’s expression turned somewhat solemn.

The so-called Void Divine Master is currently the overseer of the Void Secret Realm.

The originator of the Void Secret Realm, the only known Tenth Stage Evil God from the Boundless Void, founded the Void Secret Realm, bestowing infinite blessings to future generations of Evil Gods.

And the Void Divine Master, also known as the Child of the Void, took over the reins of the Void Secret Realm after the originator disappeared.

The Child of the Void itself is not a Tenth Stage Evil God, but by leveraging the Void Secret Realm, can exert a power almost equivalent to the Tenth Stage, the strongest Evil God within the vast boundless Void.

“Controlling the Void Secret Realm is indeed a bit troublesome.”

Lin Yuan thought with a slightly grave expression.

At least, if the opposition utilizes the multiple Spatial Layers of the Void Secret Realm, taking advantage of their home ground, even if Lin Yuan uses all his trump cards, he cannot kill the opposition.

Even by employing the Divine Ability ‘World’, if the opponent hides within the Void Secret Realm, it is still untouchable.

The entire Void Secret Realm can also be viewed as a colossal world.

Moreover, the Void Secret Realm affects an extremely vast area, even capable of influencing the entirety of the Boundless Void.

“According to the memories of Tianzhi True Lord, that Void Divine Master, most of the time, is plunged into slumber, deeply contemplating the Origin Source of the Void Secret Realm, hoping to thereby step into the Tenth Stage…”

Lin Yuan secretly thought.

To that Child of the Void, everything in the Boundless Void is within the grip of his hand, his only pursuit being to become the second originator of the Void Secret Realm, to become a Tenth Stage Evil God.

“Plenty of treasures indeed.”

Lin Yuan casually extracted many treasures from Tianzhi True Lord.

After a casual inventory, placed them all within a certain part of his internal world.

Planning to, upon concluding the traversal, revert them with Primal Force back to the Origin Source, then integrate them into the Origin Clock.

Indirectly bringing them back to the Main Universe.

“Continue contemplating the Secret Skill ‘Milky Way’, I can feel that I am not far from comprehending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm.”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes, his body once again began rippling with the vast ‘Milky Way’ composed entirely of space and time.

…

Somewhere in the Boundless Void.

The Eastern Wing Lord gathers with over a dozen Complete Demon True Lords.

“How come Tianzhi hasn’t replied to me for so long?” The Eastern Wing Lord’s brows slightly furrowed.

He, following the instructions of Tianzhi True Lord, gathered other Complete Demon True Lords, wanting to deal with that emerging Taiyin Sovereign.

Now everything was ready, but there was no contact from Tianzhi True Lord?

This gave the Eastern Wing Lord a headache.

According to the initial plan, during the ambush of the Taiyin Sovereign, it must be commanded by Tianzhi True Lord.

Only through Tianzhi True Lord’s deduction and arrangement could they suppress the Taiyin Sovereign with the smallest cost.

Otherwise, even if the Taiyin Sovereign was foolish, knowing that more than ten Complete Demon True Lords were approaching would have made him flee in advance, and in the vast Boundless Void, the Taiyin Sovereign intent on escaping could eventually lead to a protracted battle.

This would not align with Tianzhi True Lord’s plan to suppress the Taiyin Sovereignas quickly as possible, annihilating Martial Tao.

After all, once the situation becomes a protracted battle, various unexpected events can occur.

“Perhaps Tianzhi is delayed by some matter.”

Another Complete Demon True Lord spoke.

He is known as the Lord Divine Eye, possessing eighteen eyes, under normal circumstances, only one would be open.

When all eighteen eyes are open, it is the strongest state of Lord Divine Eye, also the time for a desperate fight.

Throughout the long years of the Boundless Void, Lord Divine Eye has never had all eighteen eyes open at once, as among Complete Demon True Lords, fatal clashes rarely occur.

“Delayed by some matter?”

The Eastern Wing Lord’s brow was tightly furrowed. Given his understanding of Tianzhi True Lord, such a possibility seemed very small.

Moreover, what matter could prevent Tianzhi True Lord from even replying to him? No matter how big the issue, wouldn’t it take just a moment to inform him, the Eastern Wing Lord?

“Let’s wait a bit longer.”

Though the Eastern Wing Lord did not believe that Tianzhi True Lord was delayed by some issue, considering they couldn’t contact him, this was the only possibility.
